# Colonial Terminals

Colonial Terminals is a Oil and Gas company. Colonial Terminals is one of the largest privately owned, independent terminal operators, providing liquid bulk, dry bulk, and breakbulk storage, handling, transloading, and distribution solutions for customers across global supply chains. Colonial Terminals employs 44 people (+10.0% YoY, +4 people) and has an annual revenue of $66M, founded in 1934. Headquartered in Savannah, Georgia, United States, with offices in Wilmington and Garden City.

## About

Colonial Terminals, Inc. (CTI) is an industry leader in the handling and storage of liquid and dry bulk products. Colonial Terminals began operations in 1934 with the construction of a 21-acre, deep-water terminal located on the Savannah River to serve the burgeoning import and export, petroleum storage market. Today, Colonial Terminals owns and operates the largest, independent, liquid and dry bulk storage facilities with breakbulk capability in the Southeastern United States.

# Colonial Group, Inc.

Colonial Group, Inc. is a Oil and Gas company. Colonial Group, Inc. is a privately held, family-owned enterprise that connects energy, chemical, marine, storage, and distribution businesses through shared infrastructure, resources, expertise, and long-term ownership. Colonial Group, Inc. employs 622 people (+5.1% YoY, +30 people) and has an annual revenue of $2.5B, founded in 1921. Headquartered in Savannah, Georgia, United States.

## About

A family company founded in 1921, Colonial’s history is rooted in the marketing, retailing, and distribution of petroleum products for the transportation, industrial, and marine applications. Over time, Colonial expanded its offerings to include natural gas marketing, liquid & dry bulk storage, maritime services, and industrial chemical sales. Today, Colonial provides industry leading levels of service, ranking #64 on Forbes List of America's Largest Private Companies.

properties.description: A family company founded in 1921, Colonial’s history is rooted in the marketing, retailing, and distribution of petroleum products for the transportation, industrial, and marine applications. Over time, Colonial expanded its offerings to include natural gas marketing, liquid & dry bulk storage, maritime services, and industrial chemical sales. Today, Colonial provides industry leading levels of service, ranking #64 on Forbes List of America's Largest Private Companies.
